title: Boundary propagation with coupled lower-order terms
source_hypothesis: Finite-rank smooth complex vector bundle; second-order differential operator with real scalar quadratic principal symbol and noncharacteristic boundary; arbitrary smooth complex lower matrices; intrinsic N solution and source with actual Dirichlet trace. Generalized-ray conclusion has the stated radial qualifications. Residual comparison additionally requires every backward ray to reach the regular region in finite time through a compact nonexceptional source-free subset.
